title: Fact suggestions
description: fact-suggestions.json, optional: card facts the fact list lacks that several cards should share. Each names the new fact, the rule that would give it from a card's data, example cards that should have it, and a one-line reason. Suggestions are reported, not applied.

fact.description: The new fact's name, in the style of the facts in facts.json.

rule.description: What in a card's data would give it the fact.

examples.description: Card ids, copied exactly from the card files, of cards that should have the fact.

reason.description: One line: why the fact would help.
